bullets.id: Emas spot turun 0,48% ke sekitar $4.120,10 pada Selasa menurut Kitco, meski data perumahan AS lemah: housing starts September turun 5,2% ke 1,221 juta. Rabu pagi emas di sekitar $4.118,90, turun 0,14%, penurunan sesi keempat beruntun menurut Trading Economics. Perak justru naik: futures ditutup $58,14, naik 1,59%.
bullets.en: Spot gold fell 0.48% to about $4,120.10 on Tuesday according to Kitco, despite weak US housing data: September housing starts fell 5.2% to 1.221 million. On Wednesday morning gold was near $4,118.90, down 0.14%, a fourth straight losing session according to Trading Economics. Silver went the other way: futures closed at $58.14, up 1.59%.

bullets.id: Brent naik ke sekitar $111,30, tertinggi sejak Mei, dan WTI sekitar $100,64, menambah kekhawatiran inflasi. Yield 10 tahun di sekitar 5,13% dan indeks dolar sekitar 101,77. Pasar memperkirakan peluang Fed menahan suku bunga pada 27–28 Oktober sekitar 83%, tetapi peluang suku bunga lebih tinggi pada 9 Desember sekitar 93,6%. Emas turun sekitar 5,6% sebulan dan sekitar 26,6% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: Brent rose to about $111.30, its highest since May, and WTI to about $100.64, adding to inflation worries. The 10-year yield is near 5.13% and the dollar index near 101.77. Markets price about an 83% chance of a Fed hold on October 27–28, but about a 93.6% chance of higher rates by December 9. Gold is down about 5.6% on the month and about 26.6% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Level dari Kitco: resistance $4.141,97 dan $4.145,47, lalu $4.199,08; support $4.073,55 dan $4.066,54, lalu $3.942,10. Agenda: pending home sales, klaim pengangguran (Kamis), PMI awal Oktober dan sentimen konsumen final (Jumat), lalu rapat Fed 27–28 Oktober.
bullets.en: Kitco’s levels: resistance at $4,141.97 and $4,145.47, then $4,199.08; support at $4,073.55 and $4,066.54, then $3,942.10. Agenda: pending home sales, jobless claims (Thursday), preliminary October PMIs and final consumer sentiment (Friday), then the October 27–28 Fed meeting.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp10.000 ke Rp2.554.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.369.000 (spread sekitar 7,2%). Galeri24 turun ke Rp2.510.000 (buyback Rp2.363.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS ke Rp2.534.000 (buyback Rp2.338.000, spread sekitar 7,7%). CIBC memangkas proyeksi rata-rata emas kuartal IV ke $4.500 dari $6.500, tetapi melihat pemulihan ke $5.200 pada 2027 berkat pembelian bank sentral 345 ton di semester I.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp10,000 to Rp2,554,000/gram with a Rp2,369,000 buyback (spread about 7.2%). Galeri24 fell to Rp2,510,000 (buyback Rp2,363,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS to Rp2,534,000 (buyback Rp2,338,000, spread about 7.7%). CIBC cut its Q4 average gold forecast to $4,500 from $6,500 but sees a recovery to $5,200 in 2027, backed by 345 tonnes of central-bank buying in the first half.
